sectors.trend: Gold discoveries across WA/Qld (Gateway, King River 44g/t, Moonlight, PLC Murchison) provide positive catalysts; coal boom supports energy miners; True North expands Qld copper zone. However, 'distrust gold' narrative amid geopolitical heat adds volatility.
sectors.implications: Gold juniors (Gateway, King River, Moonlight, PLC) see near-term upside; BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX supported by coal strength but face iron ore softness risk. Auric's $28M profit validates WA gold economics.

sectors.trend: Mortgage stress at 18-year highs pressures NPLs; 4th rate hike looms squeezing margins; CBA fee controversy (13-year inactive card charges) damages brand; housing correction threatens loan book quality.
sectors.implications: CBA.AX, NAB.AX, ANZ.AX, WBC.AX face margin compression and credit cost headwinds. Rate hike supports NIM but housing downturn offsets. Defensive positioning warranted.

sectors.trend: Coal booms as Chinese solar overtakes coal capacity globally; Premier urges Chinese/Indian coal firm merger before funding stops. Oil elevated, fuelling inflation and rate fears.
sectors.implications: Coal producers (WDS.AX, LNC.AX, BOQ.AX) benefit from sustained demand. LNG names (WDS.AX, GWO.AX) supported by elevated oil. Transition risk long-term.

sectors.trend: Grocery bills set to rise faster; Qantas ground crews vote for strike; small business uncertainty elevated. Inflation 'home grown' pressures real incomes.
sectors.implications: WES.AX, WOW.AX face input cost pressure but benefit from defensive demand. QAN.AX strike risk is a near-term catalyst. Consumer staples outperform in rate-hike environment.

sectors.trend: Housing 'bloodbath' predicted with 10% price fall; Bathla developer near insolvency; 'Evergrande moment' for mega developer; housing affordability crisis deepens.
sectors.implications: Property developers (GPT.AX, CGP.AX, DVH.AX) face severe distress. Residential REITs (PGY.AX, DGP.AX) pressured by rate hikes. Commercial REITs (ICP.AX, SPG.AX) relatively insulated but yield-sensitive.

sectors.trend: AI bubble concerns (Iran 'bombs AI bubble'); Uber cuts 3,300 roles; Dell surges on AI server orders; Citi recommends buying tumbling tech. Mixed signals.
sectors.implications: ASX tech (W1.AX, XRO.AX, SVL.AX) volatile. Global AI capex cycle (Dell surge) supports hardware but sentiment fragile. Canva (CVA - private) privacy legal fight noted.

market_outlook.short_term: ASX likely to remain under pressure (1–3 months) as 4th RBA hike risk, housing correction fears, and elevated bond yields dominate. Gold miners and coal names provide relative outperformance. Qantas strike and developer insolvencies add idiosyncratic risk. Expect ^AXJO to trade in a range with downside bias.
market_outlook.long_term: 6–12 month outlook cautious: per-capita recession and productivity deterioration cap earnings growth. However, commodity cycle (coal, gold) and eventual RBA pivot could support recovery. Housing correction may take 12–18 months to stabilise. Structural energy transition (Chinese solar) is a long-term headwind for thermal coal but supports LNG.
